title: How Bluetooth Sends Music to Your Headphones

vo.text: The music reaches your headphones without a cable.
vo.speak: The music reaches your headphones without a cable.

vo.text: First, the phone represents the music as digital audio samples.
vo.speak: First, the phone represents the music as digital audio samples.

vo.text: Bluetooth usually compresses those samples so they fit within the available data rate.
vo.speak: Bluetooth usually compresses those samples so they fit within the available data rate.

vo.text: The compressed stream is divided into small packets.
vo.speak: The compressed stream is divided into small packets.

vo.text: Each packet carries control information alongside the audio data.
vo.speak: Each packet carries control information alongside the audio data.

vo.text: The paired devices transmit these packets over short-range radio.
vo.speak: The paired devices transmit these packets over short-range radio.

vo.text: They rapidly change frequencies in a coordinated pattern, helping avoid interference.
vo.speak: They rapidly change frequencies in a coordinated pattern, helping avoid interference.

vo.text: Your headphones receive the packets and check that the data arrived correctly.
vo.speak: Your headphones receive the packets and check that the data arrived correctly.

vo.text: They reassemble and decode the audio stream.
vo.speak: They reassemble and decode the audio stream.

vo.text: Digital samples become radio packets, then become music again through the headphone's converter and driver.
vo.speak: Digital samples become radio packets, then become music again through the headphone's converter and driver.
